Label: Toronto Alexithymia Scale - 26 items
Description: Toronto Alexithymia Scale - 26 items (TAS-26). Measures alexithymia. 26 items, 5-point scale. Reference: Taylor, G. J., Ryan, D., & Bagby, R. M. (1985). Toward the development of a new self-report alexithymia scale. Psychotherapy and Psychosomatics, 44(4), 191-199. German version: Kupfer, J., Brosig, B., & Brähler, E. (2000). Testing and validation of the 26-Item Toronto Alexithymia Scale in a representative population sample. Zeitschrift für Psychosomatische Medizin und Psychotherapie, 46(4), 368-384.
